clues: This town sits in the state of Perak in Malaysia. It lies north west of the state main town and south east of George Town.
This town is the wettest on the mainland. Huge rain falls each year, and it makes the plants and rain trees thrive.
It was the state main town from 1876 to 1937, then lost that role when Ipoh took its place.
This town ranks in the top three towns in the world for green, clean ways of life, a prize few towns can claim.
Its best known sight is its Lake Gardens. Great rain trees stand there in rich green growth, fed by the heavy rain.
